<!-- first-contribution-welcome -->

Thank you for your first pull request to Verticopolis, @{login}! 🎉

We really appreciate you taking the time to dig in. Here is what happens next:

- A maintainer will read it soon. Automated checks and review bots may leave notes too. Treat them as suggestions, and ask here if one is unclear.
- If a check fails and you can't tell why, leave a comment and we'll help sort it out.
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/{repo}/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md) covers setup, the quality gates and how reviews work.

Want to keep going? We'd love the help. Issues labeled [good first issue](https://github.com/{repo}/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22good+first+issue%22) or [help wanted](https://github.com/{repo}/issues?q=is%3Aissue+is%3Aopen+label%3A%22help+wanted%22) are a good place to start, and you're welcome to comment on any open issue to say you'd like to pick it up.
